positions.description:

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description:
-Providing various businesses with technological support, strategy and guidance

-Providing support and maintenance on existing projects and systems

positions.title: New Media Development
positions.description: Moose DM is a full service e-marketing and direct mail firm. I provided direct and e-marketing solutions to clients like The Financial Times, including subscription management and retention tools and custom programming to fit their needs. This was a long-term consulting role.

positions.title: Partner
positions.description:
Provided clients with custom and turnkey solutions in web design, development and presence. App development (mobile and desktop) for iOS and Android platforms, as well as Mac OS X and Windows platforms. 

Dynamique also provided graphic, illustration and design services. In addition, we pride ourselves on our social media development and maintenance team, which delivers our customers strong marketing results and improved relationships with their clients.

positions.title: Manager - Agency Services

-Managed and improved relationships with clients and improved company revenues via up-sells, custom coding projects, etc.
